description: Fetch all files the user uploaded via the hosted upload page. Returns one mcp_upload_id per file — pass each to the appropriate tool (add_clips, add_article_media, etc.). Call this once after the user confirms they are done uploading; the token covers all files they dropped on the page.

upload_token.description: The upload_token returned by upload_file(request_hosted_upload: true)

name: check_uploads
title: Check upload status
